native_context: Payment amount, recipient and order-state integrity
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Payment amount, recipient and order-state integrity — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Map trusted catalog/order amount/currency/recipient, payment provider event, order binding and paid-state transition. Use a provider sandbox or inert local payment fixture.
controls.controlled_verification: Compare a legitimate order payment with one caller-controlled mismatch derived from source: amount, currency, order or recipient. Inspect trusted provider event verification and the durable order ledger. An accepted checkout request is not proof of settled/fulfilled state.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A client price used only for display is not price tampering. A signed provider event can still be bound to the wrong order, while a rejected mismatched event defeats that specific hypothesis.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Compute authoritative order values server-side and bind verified payment evidence to the exact order/recipient/state with idempotency. Retest legitimate settlement, original mismatch and bounded duplicate event.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
